A dramatic coastline far beneath, white cliffs plunging into a churning jade sea, surf breaking in silent white lines on the rocks below, the ocean spreading to a misty infinite horizon.
A great fantasy castle-city clinging to a sheer crag far below, towers and battlements tiered up the rock face, a whole city clustered at its feet, roads radiating outward like spokes.

Rolling farmland far beneath, a patchwork of green and gold fields divided by hedgerows and stone walls, tiny villages with smoking chimneys clustered at crossroads, the whole quilt softening into haze at the horizon.
A vast desert of amber dunes far below, wind-sculpted ridges casting long purple shadows, and at the edge of sight a distant oasis glittering green and silver against the burning emptiness.

A frozen tundra stretching away below, pale as bone, veined with dark rivers locked in ice, ancient glaciers pushing blue-white tongues into valleys, the whole frozen world fading into white sky at the rim.

A canyon-land far beneath, a labyrinth of red-rock mesas and soaring stone spires casting knife-thin shadows into purple depths, dry riverbeds threading the canyon floors like cracked veins of pale sand.

A glittering archipelago far below, dozens of green islands scattered across an impossibly blue sea, white surf ringing each one, shallow lagoons glowing turquoise, the open ocean deepening to dark indigo at the edges.

A misty valley far beneath, hidden between steep green walls, waterfalls dropping in silver threads from unseen heights, the valley floor invisible beneath a churning sea of white mist lit gold by slanted sun.

A volcanic badland far below, black lava fields cracked and smoking, cinder cones trailing dark plumes across a sullen sky, a river of molten orange splitting the darkness, ash clouds drifting slowly northward.

An ancient ruined city far beneath, vast stone avenues and shattered colonnades swallowed by jungle, trees erupting through palace floors, moss-green ziggurat crowns rising above the canopy, the whole ruin breathing with green life.

A high alpine plateau far below, a cold grey lake perfectly still between bare granite ridges, a single road hairpinning down through switchbacks, tiny figures of a caravan moving like slow insects along it.
A wide estuary far beneath, a great river spreading into a braided delta of silver channels and mudflats, a walled port city on one bank, tall ships moored like scattered toys in the harbor.

Rolling chalk downs far below, pale green hills smooth as a sleeping giant, long barrow mounds and standing stone circles visible from this height as tiny dark marks, a silver stream cutting the valley floor.

A vast swamp far beneath, dark water threading between islands of tangled cypress, plumes of white egrets rising in clouds, channels catching the light between the trees, the whole waterlogged world fading into grey horizon-mist.
A great inland sea far below, steel-blue and enormous, a distant shore just a dark line at the edge of vision, a fleet of tiny warships leaving spreading white wake-trails across the dark water.
Terraced rice fields climbing steep hillsides far below, each terrace a mirror of pale sky and green shoot, a hill-town of red-roofed towers at the summit, mountain peaks rising beyond into cloud.

A wind-scoured steppe far beneath, tawny grass bending in great silver waves, a vast nomad encampment of circular tents clustered near a dark lake, horse herds moving like slow brown rivers across the plain.

A dense web of forest roads far below, a great trading crossroads town at the center, wagons and carts reduced to moving specks, the roads radiating into the darkening forest in every direction like threads.

A high moorland far beneath, purple heather and black peat bog stretching wide, a lone ancient tower standing on a hill, storm-light breaking through clouds in shafts that sweep across the land like searching fingers.

A deep rift valley far below, sheer escarpment walls dropping thousands of feet to a distant green floor, a river thin as a hair on the valley bottom, clouds drifting at mid-level within the rift itself.

A fantasy city of white towers on a wide river far beneath, bridges arching between banks, market squares and garden-rooftops visible from altitude, the river carrying it all toward a distant sea-glint on the horizon.

A primordial wetland delta far below, endless braided channels through reed-beds and black mud islands, flocks of birds lifting in vast white spirals, the whole flat world merging seamlessly with a grey and featureless sky.
A great winding river far beneath, coiling like hammered silver through golden plains, tiny farmsteads and ox-cart roads stitched along its banks, the whole world flattening to haze at the edge.
A desert of rolling dunes far below, the sand rippled like frozen waves, a distant oasis a dark smear of green around a glittering pool, heat haze swallowing the horizon.
A frozen tundra stretching endlessly beneath, blue-white glaciers carving slow rivers through pale rock, a vast silence made visible in the emptiness below, only shadow and ice and distance.

A canyon-land of mesas and red-rock spires far below, shadow-filled gorges cutting deep between the plateaus, tiny winding trails tracing the canyon floors, the whole landscape burning amber in low light.
An archipelago of green islands scattered across a deep blue sea below, white surf ringing every shore, a fleet of tiny ships threading the straits, the ocean deepening to indigo toward the horizon.
